# TecnoMart

> TecnoMart is Hyderabad's premier authorized electronics showroom and specialized repair center located in Tolichowki, Hyderabad, India. Specializing in brand-new Apple, Samsung, OnePlus, and Google smartphones; high-performance laptops (MacBook, ASUS ROG, Dell XPS, Lenovo Legion, HP); custom water-cooled ARGB gaming desktop PCs; Grade-A+ certified refurbished devices; genuine computer accessories; and same-day certified hardware repairs.

TecnoMart operates as an omnichannel digital catalogue with instant in-store pickup and doorstep express delivery across Hyderabad and Secunderabad within 3–4 hours. Customers can explore live specifications, compute trade-in exchange values, calculate monthly EMI plans, customize PC builds component-by-component, and consult directly with certified hardware technicians via WhatsApp or in-store.

Operating Hours: Monday – Sunday: 10:00 AM – 09:30 PM (IST)
Flagship Store: 7 Tombs Rd, Raghava Colony, Neeraj Colony, Toli Chowki, Hyderabad, Telangana 500008, India
Official Hotline: +91 98663 88870
Direct WhatsApp Consultation: https://wa.me/919866388870
Official Website: https://www.tecnomart.in (also accessible at https://www.tecnomart.in)

## Catalogs

- [Smartphones & Mobiles](https://www.tecnomart.in/mobiles): Complete flagship and mid-range mobile lineup including Apple iPhone 16/15 Pro Max, Samsung Galaxy S25/S24 Ultra, OnePlus, and Google Pixel with official manufacturer warranty.
- [Laptops & Ultrabooks](https://www.tecnomart.in/laptops): Business laptops, thin-and-light ultrabooks, student notebooks, and high-performance creator workstations from Apple, Dell, Lenovo, HP, and ASUS.
- [Accessories & Peripherals](https://www.tecnomart.in/accessories): Mechanical keyboards, precision gaming mice, studio headphones, wireless neckbands, 4K monitors, fast chargers, GaN adapters, and protective cases.
- [Custom Gaming PCs](https://www.tecnomart.in/gaming): Pre-configured and bespoke liquid-cooled gaming battle stations with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090/4080/4070 Super and AMD Ryzen 7000/9000 processors.
- [Certified Refurbished](https://www.tecnomart.in/refurbished): Grade-A+ pre-owned iPhones, MacBooks, and premium devices certified through 32-point hardware inspection with 6-month TecnoMart warranty.
- [Tech Insights & Buyer Guides](https://www.tecnomart.in/blogs): In-depth hardware comparisons, genuine Apple accessory verification guides, and expert buying advice.

## Services & Tools

- [Device Repairs & Diagnostics](https://www.tecnomart.in/repairs): Same-day hardware service for cracked screens, battery replacements, motherboard chip-level repair, thermal repasting, and liquid damage recovery.
- [Custom PC Builder Tool](https://www.tecnomart.in/pc-builds): Interactive real-time PC configurator with live wattage calculation, bottleneck checking, and instant quote generation.
- [Trade-In Exchange Calculator](https://www.tecnomart.in/exchange): Instant valuation tool to trade in old smartphones and laptops for immediate store credit toward new purchases.
- [EMI Finance Calculator](https://www.tecnomart.in/emi-calculator): Flexible 0% interest and low-cost monthly EMI payment plan estimator with major Indian bank partners.
- [Product Comparison Tool](https://www.tecnomart.in/compare): Side-by-side technical specification, benchmark, and price comparison engine.
- [Interactive Spin & Win Machine](https://spin.tecnomart.in): Customer loyalty reward machine with guaranteed prizes, instant 2.5D digital pass issuance, and in-store QR verification.

## Programs & Offers

- [Flash Deals & Clearance](https://www.tecnomart.in/deals): Time-sensitive discounts, festive bundle bundles, and open-box clearance offers.
- [Corporate Bulk Procurement](https://www.tecnomart.in/corporate): Enterprise IT hardware leasing, bulk fleet deployment, GST invoicing, and dedicated account management.
- [Student Discount Program](https://www.tecnomart.in/students): Exclusive educational discounts on MacBooks, laptops, tablets, and accessories for verified university students and teachers.
